statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p), χ ≠ 1 → χ^2 = 1 → ∀ t : ZMod p, t ≠ 0 → (∑ a : ZMod p, χ a * χ (t-a)) = -χ (-1)

plain_statement.en: New route · Characters and extended arcs · CW-8002 · Evaluate the Jacobi term when the prime conductor misses the target

brief.zh: 换元 a=t u，利用 χ(t)²=1。再用 u/(1−u) 将去掉 u=1 的和化为非平凡特征和。两种符号均保留。
brief.en: Scale by t using χ(t)²=1. On u≠1 use u/(1−u) and the complete nontrivial character sum. Retain the parity sign.
